low level of consciousness on admission
cohort: 169 women with preeclampsia and 287 controls in Brazil
finding: High pre-pregnancy BMI, first pregnancy, and low level of consciousness on admission were associated with preeclampsia, while univariate analysis suggested a potential role for IL1B gene polymorphism.
mod_finding: Cesarean section was associated with preeclampsia in univariate analysis but not after multivariate logistic regression.
